description: This Java class implements a Hibernate Search ValueBridge that converts java.util.Locale objects to their string representations for indexing and vice versa. It is used in the context of indexing locale data for search capabilities within the OpenMRS platform, specifically since version 2.8.0.

classes.name: LocaleValueBridge
classes.description: A Hibernate Search ValueBridge implementation for serializing and deserializing java.util.Locale objects to strings for indexing purposes.

methods.name: toIndexedValue
methods.description: Converts a Locale object into its string representation for indexing.

methods.name: fromIndexedValue
methods.description: Converts a string value from the index back into a Locale object.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a string into a Locale object and returns its string representation.
